title: unlimitedsigntext
description: makes signs and hanging signs have unlimited amount of text, fully client side
body:
# unlimitedsigntext
### this mod removes the sign text limit client side (most servers accept it)
the main use of this mod is to allow you to 'search' items in a storage terminal on a server that has too long item names to search.

## attribution
this project's 2 mixins are from https://github.com/70CentsApple/word-overflow/
this is basically a port of word overflow to 26.1.2
